card_title: Artist Notes: Hydrating Body Mist: Rosewater
summary: Atmospheric hydration. A micro-fine, water-based mist that lightly scents the body while flooding the skin with botanical moisture.
description: The subtle veil. Stripped of heavy fixatives, this mist offers the pure, unadulterated essence of distilled rose petals, providing an instant cooling effect and a fleeting, romantic aura.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 250ml, this KoColor BODY_MIST is expertly formulated with Rosa Damascena Distillate, Water, and Glycerin. It delivers a high-fidelity Petal Water color profile (`#FFE4E1`) and leverages rapid aqueous diffusion.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Mist liberally over the entire body immediately after showering while the skin is still damp.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Spray directly onto your bed linens 5 minutes before sleeping for a calming, aromatherapeutic environmental shift.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Distillate is captured during the exact moment of essential oil extraction, retaining water-soluble phytonutrients that standard perfumes lack.
